scope: Sequential imports into a single knowledge base. Score Service identity and CALLS direction, endpoints, and contribution source. The generic title PGW does not resolve an endpoint.

calls.phrase: PGW-East (app_id pay-east) calls the production Clearing Service (app_id clearing-prod) to settle captured transactions.

repeat.expected: Same Service and CALLS graph IDs and contribution sources after retry.

withdraw.expected: Only the registry contribution remains. All four Service IDs are preserved and the production CALLS relation is removed.
